description: This Dart source file defines common reusable Flutter widgets used across the UI, including CardShell for styled container cards with optional icons and actions, a loading placeholder, and an EmptyState widget for indicating empty list states.

classes.name: CardShell
classes.description: A customizable card container widget with theming and optional icon, title, and action elements. It includes a static method for displaying loading placeholders or the actual content.

classes.name: _LoadingBar
classes.description: A private widget used internally within CardShell to display a shimmering loading bar as a placeholder.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget that displays a message and icon indicating an empty or idle state, with a compact mode option.

methods.name: CardShell.loadingOrChild
methods.description: Returns either a shimmer-like loading placeholder or the provided child widget, depending on the isLoading flag.

methods.name: CardShell.build
methods.description: Builds the styled container with optional header and content, handling tap gestures.

methods.name: _LoadingBar.build
methods.description: Constructs a fractional width container styled as a loading placeholder.

methods.name: EmptyState.build
methods.description: Builds the empty state widget, either compact or full, with icon and message.
